note: WP-49 adds two interactive tools and the /tools/ hub. Every formula, folder, item and statement in the new copy traces to a published page of this site, or is labelled below as a convention or an editorial choice. No amount, benchmark, target, seat count, price, date, statistic, person, company or testimonial is introduced. The entries map each block to its origin.

sources.title: Early-stage SaaS metrics: definitions and formulas, appendix formula table
sources.exact_url_or_locator: src/content/research/early-stage-saas-metrics-definitions.md, section 'Appendix: formula table and reporting checklist'
sources.next_review: Any change to the brief's formula table
sources.variables_units_scope: Three formulas are shown exactly as the brief's table publishes them: NRR ('[(Beginning recurring revenue - MRR lost from churn - MRR lost from downgrades + revenue from upgrades) / Beginning recurring revenue] x 100'), simple CAC ('MCC / CA') and CLV ('Margin x (Retention / (1 + Discount - Retention))'). Revenue churn is the brief's customer-churn formula with 'Customers lost' replaced by 'Churned MRR' and 'Total customers during period' replaced by 'Starting MRR'; it is labelled 'Adapted from the research brief'. The six-question reporting checklist on the calculator page is the brief's checklist.
sources.methodology_limitations: tests/unit/wp-49/formulas.test.ts parses the brief's table and checks each brief-sourced formula character for character, and the adapted swap. The brief gives no benchmarks and no target values, and neither does the calculator. The discount term in CLV is fixed at zero and the page says so.
sources.license_access_attribution: Internal; quoted from the site's own brief
sources.freshness_trigger: Any change to the brief's formula table or checklist

sources.title: Five calculator results the research brief does not define
sources.exact_url_or_locator: src/components/islands/we-calc/formulas.ts, METRICS entries netNewMrr, quickRatio, cacPayback, ltvToCac, runway
sources.next_review: When the research brief is extended to define these results (open request to WP-47 and WP-50)
sources.variables_units_scope: Net new MRR = new + expansion - contraction - churned MRR. Quick ratio = (new + expansion MRR) / (churned + contraction MRR). CAC payback = CAC / (average new-customer MRR x gross margin), in months. LTV to CAC = LTV / CAC. Runway = cash / net monthly burn, in months. Each is shown on the page labelled 'A convention: the research brief does not define it', with its assumptions, so a reader can recompute it.
sources.methodology_limitations: These are common reporting arithmetic, not published definitions the site can cite. The brief says ratios of lifetime value to cost are sometimes quoted and publishes no target; the page repeats that and shows no benchmark. A unit test confirms none of the five names appears in the brief.
sources.freshness_trigger: Any definition added to the brief

sources.title: Suggested stage for each evidence-room item
sources.exact_url_or_locator: src/components/islands/we-evidence-room/items.ts, the stage of each row and READINESS_STAGE
sources.variables_units_scope: Neither guide ranks items by company stage. The stage on each item is WE's own suggested order for gathering evidence, using the three of the four published stage labels (Idea or prototype, First product, Early customer evidence). The fourth stage, 'Several products, or a regulated field', has no filter of its own: the page tells that company to show all items and ask its own counsel what else applies.
sources.methodology_limitations: Editorial sequencing. The page labels it 'a suggestion, not an investor requirement' and does not claim any investor asks for items in this order.
sources.freshness_trigger: Any change to the stage labels in src/components/pricing/stages.ts

sources.title: What each tool does with the visitor's input
sources.variables_units_scope: 'Your numbers stay on this page' (calculator: nothing saved, sent or placed in the address) and 'your ticks are kept in the part of the address after the # sign' (evidence room: no storage, no cookie, no request) restate what the code does. The e2e specs record every request after the page loads and fail on any, and read local storage, session storage and cookies after use.
sources.methodology_limitations: The evidence-room address holds the ticks, so anyone given the address sees them; the page says so.
sources.freshness_trigger: Any change that adds storage or a request
